_note: The canonical dial registry every Frequency theme implements. A dial is one owner-facing control. Each names its tier, its options, what it drives (a token modifier, a root data attribute, a component variant or a record field) and the invariants a theme must pass for it. Themes may ADD dials (tier 'theme') but may not remove or rename a core one; a theme that does not vary on a core dial declares it 'fixed' and the editor hides it.

tiers.look: Layer 0. Named presets of every dial below, shown as preview cards. One tap sets everything.
tiers.simple: Layer 1. Always visible. Three dials, no more.
tiers.advanced: Layer 2. One tap down ('More'). Grouped: Shape, Type, Motion, Layout, Order. One Reset.
tiers.block: Layer 3. Inside a block, on the block. Variant and per-block switches only.
tiers.theme: A dial one theme adds. Appears in Advanced under its own group, flagged with the theme name.

dials.label: Kit
dials.note: Sets the words, the sample rows and which functions are on. Never sets colour or type.

dials.label: Accent
invariants: Every derived step (hover, text, soft, deep, two glows) is computed from the one accent.
Accent text on bg ≥ 4.5:1 in both registers; filled button label ≥ 3:1 at ≥ 12px bold, else the theme substitutes its darker step.

dials.label: Register
invariants: Only the ink and chrome scales re-map. No block names a colour.

dials.label: Type voice
invariants: One display class, three voices. Layout never moves: line-height and tracking are set per voice so blocks keep their height within 8%.

dials.label: Motion
invariants: Effects are additive layers over a finished static page.

dials.label: Hero
invariants: Photo variants have a designed empty state; a site with no photo still looks finished.

dials.label: Header
dials.note: Extends the existing pill|bar with centered.

dials.label: Section order
dials.options: home blocks the kit has on
invariants: Blocks for functions the kit has off are hidden, never rendered empty.

dials.label: Block layout
dials.note: The design's existing per-block variants (split, grid, list, cards...). Stays on the block.

modifiers._note: DTCG Resolver Module 2025.10 shape. The theme contract resolves base sets through these modifiers; the editor only ever changes a modifier's context.

looks._note: Layer 0 presets: a theme ships 4 to 6 named combinations of every dial, with a preview card. Picking one writes each dial; the owner can then change any single dial. 'Theme's own' is always the first card.
